content.title: When Does ‘The Pitt’ Season 2 Episode 11 Come Out? How and Where to Watch
content.text: Key Points'The Pitt' Season 2, Episode 11 streams tonight at 9:00 p.m. ET on HBO Max.The latest episode promises more jaw-dropping interpersonal conflicts and heart-racing medical cases as staff continue to deal with an influx of patients.Plus, things get a little too real when ICE enters the ER. One of these episodes of The Pitt, things are finally going to start winding down, but Episode 11 is not the one. With only five more hours of Season 2, the night-shifters are soon to arrive and the day crew will begin trying to find the right time to go home, but with a mass casualty incident only just getting underway and plenty of interpersonal conflicts quickly escalating, there’s still far too much to resolve before that can happen. Read More Here’s everything you need to know about the latest episode of The Pitt Season 2. Season 2, Episode 11 of The Pitt will stream on HBO Max starting on Thursday, March 19 at 9:00 p.m. ET/6:00 p.m. PT. What time does The Pitt Season 2, Episode 11 air tonight? New episodes of The Pitt are always available starting at 9:00 p.m. ET/6:00 p.m. PT, every Thursday on HBO Max. What will happen in The Pitt Season 2, Episode 11 tonight? With park-goers still missing, fatalities starting to stack up, and a pending limb reimplantation by a familiar face playing the part of an orthopedic surgeon, the adrenaline is sure to keep pumping in the 6 o’clock hour. However, Roxie’s potentially impending death certainly helps to bring down the mood, while the mystery of Robby’s old friend Duke and the aftermath of Dr. Javadi’s mistake add a certain level of stress to the mix. Plus, the ER may be one doctor down after Dr. Robby ordered Dr. Mohan to go home following her panic attack, risking even further strain on the staff as the line of patients waiting to be seen continues to grow, especially as the series takes on a pair of serious, real-world topics: a patient in the custody of ICE and a little boy who appears to have been left in a hot car.
